name: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine)
description: Water-soluble vitamin; pyridoxine is its plant form, turned into pyridoxal phosphate in the body

status.humanEvidence: FDA approved; no trials for energy

note.text: No published human study of injected B6, alone or in lipotropic blends, for energy or fat loss was found.

bullets: **Label:** turned into pyridoxal phosphate, which helps enzymes break down nutrients
Works in **protein, carbohydrate and fat** metabolism
**For energy or fat loss,** a mechanism in people is not established
FDA approved injection for B6 deficiency (1972)
No human study of B6 injections for energy
No study of B6 in lipotropic blends

practical.pharmacokinetics: Broken down to 4-pyridoxic acid in liver; excreted in urine
practical.monitored: Label lists paresthesia, sleepiness, low folic acid

regulatory.text: Not listed; IV over 100 mL per 12 h banned (M2.2)

references: FDA (DailyMed), Pyridoxine Hydrochloride Injection USP label, Oct 2024
FDA, Drugs@FDA data for pyridoxine (openFDA), Oct 2026
